updates.u1title: Eid Special — Ghee aur Paneer par 10% chhoot
updates.u1body: Is Eid par hamare sabhi customers ko ghee aur paneer par 10% ki special chhoot milegi. Offer 1–5 Aug tak valid hai. WhatsApp karein aur order karein.
updates.u2title: Farm mein 3 nayi gaayein aayi hain
updates.u2body: Hamare farm mein 3 nayi desi gaayein aayi hain. Isse cow milk ki supply aur behtar ho jaayegi. Shuddh doodh, aur bhi zyada.
updates.u3body: Ab Jhanjharpur aur aaspaas ke ilakon mein bhi daily delivery shuru ho gayi hai. Agar aap wahan rehte hain toh abhi enquiry karein.
updates.u4title: Naye customers ke liye — pehle 7 din special rate
updates.u4body: Agar aap pehli baar hamare saath doodh lena shuru kar rahe hain, toh pehle 7 din special rate par milega. Koi hidden charge nahi.
updates.u5title: Monsoon mein doodh ki quality aur achhi
updates.u5body: Baarish ke mausam mein hamare janwaron ko taza hara chara milta hai jisse doodh ki quality naturally behtar ho jaati hai. Yeh season hamare liye sabse achha hota hai.
updates.u6title: Monthly billing ab WhatsApp par bhi milegi
updates.u6body: Ab hamare customers ko har mahine ka bill WhatsApp par bhi bheja jaayega. Transparent billing, koi confusion nahi.
